seoTitle: How to Add a Tracking Number to an eBay Order
metaDescription: Learn how to add or edit a tracking number on a sold eBay item from desktop or mobile, and why timely tracking protects your seller account.
intro: Adding a tracking number after you ship an item confirms the sale for the buyer and protects you if a delivery dispute ever comes up. This guide covers how to attach tracking to a sold listing on both the eBay website and the mobile app.

steps.heading: Locate the sold item
steps.body: In Seller Hub or the 'Selling' section, find the order you've shipped and open its details page.

steps.heading: Enter the carrier and tracking number
steps.body: Select the shipping carrier — USPS, FedEx, UPS, or another courier — and paste in the tracking number eBay uses to match it against delivery records.

steps.heading: Confirm the buyer is notified
steps.body: Once saved, eBay automatically emails the buyer with the tracking details so you don't need to message them separately.

steps.heading: Edit tracking if it changes
steps.body: If you entered the wrong number or switched carriers, you can go back into the order and update the tracking information at any time before delivery.

steps.heading: Handle late or missing tracking numbers
steps.body: If a carrier hasn't issued a number yet, add it as soon as it's available — delays can affect your seller performance metrics, so don't leave orders unmarked for long.

faq.question: What happens if I forget to add tracking on eBay?
faq.answer: Without tracking, you have less protection if a buyer claims non-receipt, and it can negatively affect your seller performance standing over time.

faq.question: Can I add tracking from the eBay mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, the mobile app lets you add or edit tracking numbers on sold orders the same way the desktop site does.

faq.question: Does adding tracking automatically mark the item as shipped?
faq.answer: Yes, entering a valid tracking number typically updates the order status to shipped and triggers the buyer notification.

faq.question: What if my carrier doesn't provide a tracking number?
faq.answer: For carriers without trackable service, you can mark the item as shipped without a number, though this offers less protection than a trackable shipment.
